charge.name: Lowered Tusks
charge.detail: Prepares a charge. The next action deals 160% damage.

gel.name: Gel Coat
gel.detail: Gain 2 Defense against the next 2 physical hits.

gust.name: Buffeting Gust
gust.detail: 85% damage; delays your next action by 25% of an action interval.

infectedBite.name: Infected Bite
infectedBite.detail: 65% damage; poison deals 2 damage for 2 of your turns.

bloodsuck.name: Bloodsuck
bloodsuck.detail: 80% damage; heals for half the HP damage dealt.

venom.name: Venomous Bite
venom.detail: 70% damage; poison deals 2 damage for 3 of your turns.

devour.name: Devour
devour.detail: 115% damage; heals for 30% of the HP damage dealt.

constrict.name: Constricting Vines
constrict.detail: Normal damage; drains 2 Mana/Stamina on an unblocked hit.

regrowth.name: Regrowth
regrowth.detail: Restores 12% Max HP instead of attacking.

packHowl.name: Call of the Alpha
packHowl.detail: Once per battle: permanently increases damage by 20%.

livingBark.name: Living Bark
livingBark.detail: Restores 6% Max HP and gains 2 Defense for 2 physical hits.

wildRoots.name: Wrath of the Roots
wildRoots.detail: 125% damage; drains 3 Mana/Stamina on an unblocked hit.

awakening.name: The Forest Awakens
awakening.detail: Phase 2: sheds armor and gains 15% damage. This action deals no damage.
